Wohnungen im Agnesviertel

Every flat for sale the scraper finds in the Agnesviertel postal codes — 50668 / 50670 / 50672 — with photos scraped from each listing. Tap a cover to page through all its pictures. These PLZ cover all of Neustadt-Nord, so the set is broader than the Veedel proper; the surest Agnesviertel hits carry a red mark.
